name: selvage-client
description: Live collaborative editing over the Selvage session protocol

commands.title: Join a session from an invite link
Open a document from the room

selvage.serverUrl.description: The server to host on, as a WebSocket address — the one a selvaged prints, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:8080. Asked for when unset.

selvage.displayName.description: The name other participants see. Asked for when unset.

selvage.autoSave.description: Save a document the room changed, once the room has settled on it. The host's working copy is the room's truth, so a remote edit that is not written leaves the file on disk stale. A guest's document is virtual and its save writes nothing; the call is what clears the editor's unsaved marker.
